## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o1 Pro
The OpenAI o1 Pro model, released on 2024-12-17, is a cutting-edge, ultra-tier language model designed for developers. This model is part of the OpenAI suite and is not open-source. With its advanced architecture, OpenAI o1 Pro excels in handling complex tasks that require deep understanding and reasoning. Its primary strengths include frontier reasoning, research, complex coding, PhD-level analysis, math olympiad, and scientific tasks.

### Technical Capabilities and Pricing
OpenAI o1 Pro boasts an impressive set of capabilities, including text, vision, streaming, system prompts, function calling, and structured outputs. The model has a context window of 200,000 tokens and can generate up to 100,000 tokens of output. The pricing for this model is as follows: $150.0 per 1M input tokens and $600.0 per 1M output tokens. For example, 1,000 calls with an average of 500 tokens would cost $375.0, while 10,000 calls would cost $3750.0, and 100,000 calls would cost $37500.0. In terms of benchmarks, OpenAI o1 Pro scores 88.0 on MMLU, 93.0 on HumanEval, and 1300 on LMSYS Arena ELO.

### Comparison and Use Cases
OpenAI o1 Pro is best suited for tasks that require advanced reasoning and analysis, such as research, complex coding, and scientific tasks. However, it may not be the most cost-effective option for bulk processing, cost-sensitive applications, simple tasks, or real-time applications requiring responses under 100ms. Compared to its competitors, such as Claude Opus 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and OpenAI o3, OpenAI o1 Pro is priced at a premium, with input and output costs of $150.0/
